title: Spectral extremes under exact cycle conditioning
summary: Let $P_n$ be the matrix of a random permutation of $n$ symbols and let $M_n=\log\max_{|z|=1}|\det(I-zP_n)|$. Cook and Zeitouni proved that $M_n/\log n$ converges in probability to a constant $x_0$ for a uniform permutation. We show that the $\sqrt{\log n}$ fluctuations of $M_n$ are carried entirely by the number of cycles $K_n$. Write $λ(s)=\log\{Γ(1+s)/Γ(1+s/2)^2\}$, let $s_κ$ minimize $(1+κλ(s))/s$ on $(0,\infty)$, and put $v(κ)=κλ'(s_κ)$ and $a_θ=λ(s_θ)/s_θ$.
